loss: MSE(Q_true / checkpoint mean_abs_Qhat), mean per checkpoint; one fixed update per shuffled checkpoint; no early stopping
feature_transform: train-candidate mean/std only; std<1e-12 replaced by1; no validation/test normalization fit; missing=0 before train normalization with separate masks
online_gain_scale: mean(abs(Qhat)) across declared feasible checkpoint candidates; max(scale,1e-12); no fullrisk/Qtrue scale
selection: top2 predicted priorities with ties broken by stable move_index; no predicted sign truncation; independently label-evaluated best of finalists and no-op
model_selection: none; all six architecture/seed runs retained; validation descriptive only; test evaluated after training and serialization
feature_cost: Qhat and reduced child step/stability/info_trace may require whole-neighborhood anchor/child computations; never assumed free
